newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to review role of foreign market makers.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to review role of foreign market makers.

text.p: The Institute of Public Credit Management intends to review regulations governing primary debt market makers, including granting admission to foreign institutions, Portugal's debt manager said.
"We intend to review the role of primary market makers and I hope that it can happen in 1997," Vitor Bento, chairman of the Institute for Public Credit Management (IGCP) told Reuters in an interview.
He said that the review formed part of the Institute's preparations for European economic and monetary union.
"We cannot close the door to admitting non-residents with the approach of monetary union," he said. --Sergio Goncalves, Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035
